title: Sandwich Mania
description: Stack the food to make a sandwich!
body:
# Description
This is a utility mod that allows you to stack food items on top of each other to create sandwiches and eat them.
**Hold the keybind** (default B key) and **use food items** on blocks with no obstruction above to place food. You can keep stacking layers indefinitely(but outline displays 8 layers at most). **Hold the keybind** and **right-click** the sandwich with an **empty hand** to dismantle it (returns all ingredients). **Sneak + right-click** with an **empty hand** to eat the sandwich.
![Sandwiches](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd900e88967e5f6c7349d8b3f0542f0b63a57c43.png)
Or it can be a not sandwich - have fun purely folding irregular food,**like this**:
![a "sandwich"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/670badbf28165a1352027a3098628e25f4dbf685.png)
## Features:
- Each food layer is rotated at different angles for a more natural, staggered appearance
- Supports vanilla and modded foods
- Returns non-food items (e.g. if your sandwich contains suspicious stew, the bowl is returned)
- Preserves status effects from food items
### Little bug
There's a very small chance you might not be able to eat a sandwich - this is a known bug I'm working to fix. For players, **exiting** and **re-entering** the world will resolve it.
